<thought>Based on the high‑resolution ESI‑MS data, the most intense ion is at m/z 276.0666, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈275.059 Da. The formula that best matches this mass and the observed ~16 % M+1 isotopic intensity (consistent with ~13 carbons) is C₁₃H₉NO₆. Therefore the molecular formula of the sample compound is C13H9O6N.</thought>
<final_answer>C13H9O6N</final_answer>
